definitions.explanation: A rapid, preliminary report of an event, especially in news media. Emphasizes speed of delivery over completeness of information.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{速報|そくほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流|なが}れた→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧。
⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧{速報|そくほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{待|ま}った→待つ：00469_matsu⟧。
examples.english: I waited for the results while watching the election flash reports.

examples.japanese: ⟦ニュース→ニュース：04437_nyuusu⟧{速報|そくほう}⟦によると→〜によると：03104_niyoruto⟧、⟦{大型|おおがた}→大型：03016_oogata⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{接近|せっきん}している→接近する：25362_sekkinsuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ことだ。
examples.english: According to the news bulletin, a large typhoon is approaching.

notes:
A compound of {速|そく} (fast) + {報|ほう} (report). Commonly seen on TV and smartphone notifications for urgent news.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦ニュース→ニュース：04437_nyuusu⟧{速報|そくほう} (news flash)
- ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧{速報|そくほう} (earthquake bulletin)
- ⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧{速報|そくほう} (election flash report)
- {速報|そくほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧ (a bulletin comes in)
- {速報|そくほう}{値|ち} (preliminary figures)

In Japan, {緊急地震速報|きんきゅうじしんそくほう} (Emergency Earthquake Early Warning) is a well-known system that sends alerts to phones before shaking arrives.
